meta.about: Every number that appears on the Aftergrip project page, with what it measures and where it came from. Written by the site copywriter on 2026-11-07. Paths are relative to the repo root. PROGRESS = private/.autopilot/PROGRESS.md (only VERIFIED rows and verdict lines used for results). PROGRESS keeps growing, so it is cited by row label (step | owner | clock), verdict line (step VERIFIED clock) or section heading, never by line number. EVID = private/.autopilot/evidence/.

status_values.verified: a test result inside a milestone that a separate verifier re-ran and marked VERIFIED in PROGRESS
status_values.measured-builder: measured by a builder inside a milestone that was later VERIFIED, but this exact number was not re-run by the verifier; used only as a stated limit
status_values.sourced: from a cited outside source (NASA, JPL, DLR, papers)
status_values.computed: calculated by a command run for this page (private/.autopilot/site/calc-facts.mjs; its output is in private/.autopilot/site/calc-facts.out.txt)
status_values.design: a design value or limit written in the app's code, with the code's own stated basis
status_values.planned: a rule or setting for work that is in progress; not a result

meta.rule: The page never shows a number that is not in this file. The ghost-arm result is 'not measured yet' (0 logged trials).
